title: hollow-derives-the-chart-chain-from-the-berths-never-from-a-stored-copy
intention: hollow.writes_to resolves the decompose berth through chain_for_ticket(), the same derivation the BUILDME entry gate already uses, instead of reading a stored chart_chain field on the ticket. The 24 stored copies are then laid down, and a probe keeps the field from coming back.
why: chart_chain is gate evidence, and a gate must not read input a hand typed. Measured 2026-09-10 at addresses: the BUILDME entry gate derives the chain from the berths (its sieve is literally named a_berthed_chart_chain_claims_the_ticket, transitions.py:1305 -> chain_for_ticket at cairn/tools/chain/chain.py:221), while hollow.py:188 reads ticket['chart_chain']['decompose'] - a stored copy with ONE reader, ZERO writers and 24 carriers. Zero writers with 24 carriers means every one was typed by hand. This is the crossings ruling on a second field, found by following that ruling rather than by looking for it.
how: (1) hollow.writes_to takes the ticket id and calls chain_for_ticket(tid)['decompose'], reusing the existing HollowUnmeasurable message verbatim when the stage is unclaimed so the two paths cannot drift in what they tell a reader. (2) A one-shot migration verb, modelled on crossings.drop_stored_crossings and writing through transitions._write_ticket with _ticket_shape read BEFORE the mutation, deletes chart_chain from all 24 carriers - and it must handle BOTH shapes, because 2 of the 24 hold a bare string. (3) cairn/tools/base/probes/no_ticket_carries_a_stored_chart_chain.py arms the WATCHME. (4) Proofs beside the code, including a corpus sweep and a regression tooth for the two bare-string carriers.
falsifier: DONE when: (a) hollow.writes_to resolves the decompose berth through chain_for_ticket() and not through the ticket; (b) zero tickets carry a chart_chain key of any shape, verified by scan; (c) a ticket with neither a stored nor a derivable chain gets a NAMED HollowUnmeasurable, never an AttributeError - the two bare-string carriers are the regression test; (d) cairn test --hollow on a ticket whose berths stand returns the same file list as before the change. HORIZON: valid until the berth store leaves instance-space or chain_for_ticket's shape changes; either event expires this and the entry gate's claim together, correctly, because they would then share one failure. WRONG INTENT if the derived read is slower than the stored read at the scale hollow calls it - hollow already breaches its own 5-minute bound at 382s, so a fix that adds hot-path cost has traded one red for a worse one. The measurement is before/after wall-clock on one ticket.
traces_to: Law 4 (physics, not policy: after this a chart chain cannot be typed). Law 7 (the AttributeError on 2 of 24 carriers is an error collapsing at a diagnostic surface). Law 8 (a hollow build must not pass - a gate reading hand-typed evidence is exactly the hollow green that is worse than a red). Law 1 (the derivation already exists; the stored copy re-derives a settled answer by hand 24 times).
